en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a low, elongated building set behind a grassy field and framed by several trees in the foreground. The structure has a tiled gabled roof with small dormer windows and many rectangular windows on two stories. On the long façade a large sign reads "Konzert‑Balletablissement." On the gable end another sign indicates an inn or guesthouse (beginning with "Gasthof…"). In the background at right, partly hidden by trees, there is a taller, more ornate building or small tower. The scene suggests a semi‑rural edge of town with open meadow in front of an entertainment or dance hall complex.
